description: An internal researcher reads the client's website and what is public about the business, and leaves a draft of how the business works for the agent to start from: what it sells, to whom, prices, where and when, channels, voice, and the questions only the owner can answer
client_copy: Lee tu web y te deja un borrador de cómo es tu negocio, para que tu agente arranque sabiendo.
_comment: SYSTEM, BECAUSE EVERY AGENT STARTS NOT KNOWING THE BUSINESS. Onboarding
asks for the website and used to promise «sigo leyendo tu web» with nothing
behind it: the engine saved the URL and nobody read it (2026-09-23 audit).
A SUB-AGENT, NOT A FACE TURN. The research is dozens of pages of web text;
run by the face it would sit in the conversation's history forever. The
researcher reads, and what comes back is one file and two lines.
IT STARTS ON ITS OWN ONCE PER WEBSITE (a ticker reads identity.json), and
the face can delegate to it again when the client asks to redo it.
